mean_level_semantics.baseControl: control-cell condition mean for every test target
mean_level_semantics.trainMean_combo: known single endpoint means add on the control scale; an unseen endpoint is replaced by the equal-condition mean of training singles
mean_level_semantics.linearModel_combo: the released predComb step explicitly replaces combination predictions with trainMean predictions
mean_level_semantics.linearModel_unseen_single: requires the R PCA/ridge implementation and its processed input state
